email_subject: Application - Performance Marketing Specialist (Junior) at Springbok
email_body:
Dear Springbok team,

I'm applying for the Performance Marketing Specialist (Junior) role. Your focus on paid, data-driven marketing matches where I want to grow. I have hands-on experience with Google Ads and GA4 from my current roles, and I enjoy digging into campaign data to understand what works and why.

At Episto, I handle SEO and content for client websites, using Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console to track results. I also built and optimized mirook.com, where I ran technical audits and improved search health. My technical background in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python helps me work with tracking and automation.

I'm eager to learn from Springbok's team, especially in campaign setup, optimization and media planning. I'm proactive, curious and ready to contribute.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Springbok team,

I'm writing to apply for the Performance Marketing Specialist (Junior) position. Your emphasis on paid, data-driven marketing and the chance to learn from experienced colleagues is exactly the environment I'm looking for. I have a technical background in digital marketing, with hands-on experience in SEO, content and web development, and I'm now eager to deepen my skills in performance marketing.

In my current roles at Episto and as a freelancer, I work with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to track and improve organic performance. I've also used Google Ads, which gave me a foundation in paid media. For mirook.com, I built and optimized a multi-page website, implemented structured data and ran technical audits that measurably improved search health. This experience taught me how data informs decisions and how small changes can impact results.

My technical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python allow me to understand tracking setups and automate repetitive tasks. I'm comfortable with data and curious about what sits behind the numbers. I enjoy collaborating with clients and colleagues, and I'm not afraid to ask questions or try new approaches.

Springbok's culture of continuous learning, with Online Marketing Labs and dedicated exploration time, strongly appeals to me. I'm proactive, team-oriented and ready to contribute to client campaigns from day one. I'm excited about the opportunity to grow with your team and help clients achieve their goals.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can add value to Springbok.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Google Analytics and Google Search Console from current digital marketing roles.
• Track record of using data to optimize websites: improved search health for mirook.com through technical audits and structured data.
• Technical foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Python, enabling effective work with tracking and automation.
• Client-facing experience at Episto, managing SEO and content for multiple websites and collaborating with team members.
• Eager to learn performance marketing, with certifications in Google Ads Search and GA4, and a proactive, data-curious mindset.
